orgs.nameEn: Canadian Forces Morale and Welfare Services (CFMWS)
orgs.nameFr: Les Services de bien-être et moral des Forces canadiennes (SBMFC)

domains.descEn: A sense of purpose in life is important to well-being. Transitioning members can feel lost or disoriented because they now need to replace the purpose they had in the military with something new.
domains.descFr: Le sentiment d’avoir un but précis dans la vie est important pour le bien-être. Les militaires en cours de transition vers la vie civile peuvent se sentir perdus ou désorientés, car ils doivent maintenant remplacer le but qu’ils avaient dans les Forces par quelque chose de nouveau.

domains.descEn: Sufficient finances are associated with independence, healthy lifestyle choices, access to health services, quality of housing, family stability, and avoidance of debt.
domains.descFr: Des ressources financières suffisantes vont de pair avec une multitude de situations positives : l’indépendance, un mode de vie sain, l’accès aux services de santé, un bon logement, la stabilité familiale et l’évitement de l’endettement.

domains.descEn: Health can be viewed as the physical, social, mental, and spiritual ability of an individual to function well.
domains.descFr: On peut définir la santé comme étant la capacité physique, sociale, mentale et spirituelle d’une personne à bien fonctionner.

domains.descEn: The life skills domain refers to the knowledge, insights and experiences that prepare military members to adapt to civilian life.
domains.descFr: Le domaine des aptitudes à la vie quotidienne se rapporte aux compétences, aux connaissances et aux expériences personnelles qui préparent les militaires à s’adapter à la vie civile.

domains.descEn: Building new civilian social networks is important to find all the resources and supports available to you as you adjust to civilian life, and to reshape your military identity into a civilian one.
domains.descFr: L’établissement de réseaux sociaux civils est essentiel pour trouver les ressources et les mesures de soutien à votre disposition pendant que vous vous ajustez à la vie civile et que vous refaçonnez votre identité militaire en identité civile.

domains.descEn: Finding a nice home to live in is only part of the story.  It's important to ensure that the physical environment you inhabit will meet your emotional needs as well.
domains.descFr: Trouver un bon logement où vivre n’est qu’un élément de l’histoire. Il importe de s’assurer que votre environnement physique répond aussi à vos besoins émotionnels.

domains.descEn: Focuses on how transitioning members and Veterans are perceived and accepted by civilian society, how they are understood, valued and supported by the community.
domains.descFr: Est axé sur la manière dont les militaires en transition et les vétérans sont perçus et acceptés par la société civile, comment ils sont compris, valorisés et soutenus par la communauté.

orgs.briefDescEn: Supporting the CAF community through fitness, recreation and leisure activities, family support, retail and personal financial services.
orgs.detailedDescEn: CFMWS is dedicated to Canadian Armed Forces members, Veterans and their families through the provision of fitness, recreation and leisure activities, family support, retail and personal financial services. Our programs and services contribute to operational readiness by making our members stronger mentally, socially, physically and financially at the individual and community level.
orgs.briefDescFr: Appui à la communauté des FAC : conditionnement physique, loisirs, soutien aux familles, services financiers et vente au détail.
orgs.detailedDescFr: Les SBMFC, dévoués aux membres et aux vétérans des FAC et à leurs familles, offrent des programmes de conditionnement physique et de loisirs, du soutien aux familles, ainsi que des services financiers personnels et des services de vente au détail. Ces programmes et services contribuent à l’état de préparation opérationnelle en rendant les membres des FAC plus forts, individuellement et collectivement, sur les plans mental, social, physique et financier.

orgs.briefDescEn: Supporting veterans with pensions, benefits, and services.
orgs.detailedDescEn: Veterans Affairs Canada provides pensions, benefits, and services to war veterans, retired and still-serving members of the Canadian Armed Forces and Royal Canadian Mounted Police, their families, as well as some civilians.
orgs.briefDescFr: Soutien aux anciens combattants avec des pensions, des avantages et des services.
orgs.detailedDescFr: Anciens Combattants Canada fournit des pensions, des avantages et des services aux anciens combattants de guerre, aux membres retraités et encore en service des Forces armées canadiennes et de la Gendarmerie royale du Canada, à leurs familles, ainsi qu’à certains civils.

orgs.briefDescEn: 1000 Islands Addiction Treatment Centre delivers structured inpatient addiction treatment grounded in evidence‑based care.
orgs.detailedDescEn: 1000 Islands takes a person‑centred approach to treatment, placing each client’s strengths, needs, goals, and preferences at the core of care. Treatment emphasizes abstinence, recovery capital, and integration of community supports into discharge planning. Family members may join a six‑week virtual Family Support Program, and clients are encouraged to participate in six months of tailored virtual aftercare. Treatment is trauma‑informed and grounded in CBT, DBT, and Motivational Interviewing.

orgs.briefDescEn: We are a network of veteran owned, veteran/reserve and family friendly Managed Service Providers in the IT & Cybersecurity compliance across Canada.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
123 Cyber exists to make our customers more competent in managing cyber risk. We take the heaviest load of supervision for governance, risk assessment and compliance off the plate for senior leaders who have zero bandwidth or knowledge in cyber security.
And we do this by employing veterans and promoting veteran owned businesses. We do not sell software or compete with Managed Service Providers. We work with them, to help grow their cyber businesses and create great career opportunities.

orgs.briefDescEn: As a veteran, I specialize in providing kinesiology services to veterans, focusing on understanding the multifaceted nature of military injuries.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
At 613 Fitness, we are proud to offer group classes, personal training, kids/teens classes, team conditioning, and clinical kinesiology services, emphasizing a holistic approach to health that encompasses physical, social, and emotional well-being.

Clinical kinesiology focuses on the science of human movement, applying evidence-based research to improve function, health, and wellness. Our services aim to treat injury, with a specific ability to help veterans, because I am a 38-year veteran.
